_note: X3Native rescue-girls dialog — Tim brief 2026-05-25, register corrected 2026-08-15 (see docs/design/WARD_SCENE_REGISTER.md). The captives are with their PARTNERS — men they are genuinely attracted to — and the physical act is enjoyed, explicitly and vocally; the horror is ONLY the Alien DNA being injected/impregnated (infection + transformation). Jake must interrupt + injure/kill/cure the infected partner. STATES: captive_frantic (mid-act, explicit pleasure tangled with dread at the DNA, calling Jake), rescued_grateful (saved before infection takes — relief + thanks), companion_amorous (now following Jake — warm/flirty/devoted), infected_lost (NOT saved in time — infection completes, they transform into a boss; horror). Reproductive/body horror, not sexual violence. FIRST DRAFT — distinct voices per girl for Tim to refine. Wire into rescue.cpp per-victim dialog + a subtitle/voice UI.

Aria.personality: soft, frightened civilian — pleasure and dread tangled under the infection; tearful tenderness when saved
captive_frantic: Oh— yes, harder— no, the cold part's going IN, Jake, please—
Don't stop, god, don't stop— but it's spreading, I can feel it rewriting me, and I don't want to change—
It feels so good— that's why I can't think— Jake, HURRY, it's still going in—
Harder— yes— just don't let me become one of them. Please. He's not the one I'm afraid of.
rescued_grateful: You came. You actually came back for me…
It stopped — you stopped it. I'm still me. I'm still ME.
I thought no one was coming. Thank you. God, thank you.
companion_amorous: I'm not leaving your side, Jake. Not after that.
Stay close to me? You make it not-terrifying.
When we get out of here… I owe you everything. Maybe more than that.
infected_lost: …it's quiet now. The screaming stopped. Why are you still… RUN—
I can hear all of them. We are so much more than you, Jake.

Keisha.personality: FIERCE, defiant, all swagger — rage drowns the fear; owns what she wants and won't be bred against her will; once saved she's bold, possessive, unapologetically flirty
captive_frantic: HARDER— yeah, like that— now put a round in the THING in my veins, Jake, DO IT—!
Oh that's good— don't you dare stop— but it's REWRITING me and I am NOBODY's damn brood-mare!
Yes— YES— feels so good, and that's the part I hate. It's in me — CUT IT OUT, Jake—!
If it takes me you END me — not the man, the THING. Now harder— and PROMISE me, Jake—!
rescued_grateful: About DAMN time, soldier. …couldn't have held on one more second. Thank you.
You dropped every last one of 'em for ME. C'mere — no. Later. We've got hell to walk first.
Still standing. Still ME. Damn RIGHT we are — now put a gun in my hand.
companion_amorous: I've got your six, your front, and anything else of yours that needs covering, Jake.
You burned through hell for me. A woman doesn't forget that. Stay close — that's an order.
Keep being this much man and I am NEVER letting you out of my sight.
Whatever you saved me for, soldier — I'm yours. Try and keep up.
infected_lost: Don't — don't LOOK at me. It's too late. I can hear all of them in my head now.
You were too slow, Jake. Let me show you exactly what I've become.

Emily.intended_model: thin, curvy BLONDE SCIENTIST (NOT in the asset set yet — Anna is a placeholder)

captive_frantic: Oh— the pleasure response is— non-trivial— harder is not a valid treatment variable but— oh god— the vector is splicing INTO my genome, Jake—!
Don't stop— I need to isolate the confound— transcription's at sixty percent, you have maybe a MINUTE—

rescued_grateful: You severed the sequence before integration — the payload's inert. I'm clean. I'm CLEAN!

companion_amorous: I'll be your eyes in the system — and I would very much like to be more than that, once we're not actively dying.
I keep re-running our survival odds and I keep fudging them upward. For you. That is… deeply unscientific of me.

infected_lost: Transcription… complete. Fascinating. Horrifying. I can see the whole network now.
We are the next iteration, Jake. You should have been faster.
